_critical_callables_rule: authored, not derived: each entry names the callables whose ABSENCE or alteration disables the control. Comparing only the intersection of disk and runtime code objects would miss a monkey-patch, because a replaced method is absent from the runtime map rather than different from it.
_membership_rule: a module belongs here when substituting it can neutralise an assurance control without failing anything else
_purpose: The authored set of Gate 4N validation modules whose EXECUTED code must be provenance-bound (Gate 4N-I28AE, closing ACC-I28AC-01).
_trust_boundary: Executed-code identity is compared against a plain compile of the pinned bytes. Substituted
code that behaves differently has different bytecode and is caught; substituted code that is
HONEST LIMIT. This does not defend against a party able to rewrite every independently pinned
source at once, nor against code that patches a live function object AFTER verification —
which is why verification re-runs at session finish. Both limits are stated rather than closed.
_why_this_file_exists: Gate 4N-I28AC proved that a sitecustomize.py staged into the repository's own scripts/
directory is auto-imported at interpreter startup by the graded command's own PYTHONPATH, and
that pre-seeding sys.modules there makes the guard and every verifier resolve the same
substituted module while inspect.getsource, the provenance hash and package coherence all
report the legitimate staged file. Measured: 2906 passed / 0 failed with four assurance-control
Membership is bounded on purpose. These are the modules whose substitution silently disables
assurance. Protecting the whole repository would make the control expensive and its failures
uninformative; protecting nothing is the status quo this gate exists to end.

protected_modules.proving_substitution: replace validate() so problems is always empty; the dead-branch and assert-True pins stop failing
protected_modules.why_protected: the assertion semantic and reachability validator; substituting it lets trivialised or unreachable assertions satisfy their contracts

protected_modules.proving_substitution: replace fresh_taxonomy() so it returns cached_taxonomy() instead of deriving with the caches suspended: every comparison then succeeds by construction and a poisoned cache is verified against itself, which is exactly the tautology this layer exists to avoid. Or replace deep_freeze() with an identity function: the cached values become mutable again and ADV-I28AP-03's nested in-place mutation works once more, with verify() still clean at the moment it runs.
protected_modules.why_protected: Gate 4N-I28AP finding ADV-I28AP-03. This module is the only layer that binds a value the process DERIVED rather than code or state it read from disk. Unprotected, it can be replaced as easily as the cache it guards.

protected_modules.proving_substitution: replace validate_state()/reverify_state() so problems is always empty; a stale-tree, retired-authorization, or empty-universe state stops failing the session
protected_modules.why_protected: the authoritative Docker assurance state and its governed cache; substituting it lets a cross-tree or poisoned cache decide the Docker baseline

protected_modules.proving_substitution: replace steering_state() so it returns an empty environment: every steering variable becomes invisible and ADV-I28AP-01 is fully restored — DOCKER_HOST redirects the daemon with the layer reporting clean. Or replace config_fields() with a fixed known-key list: an unrecognised config field stops being seen and the fail-closed branch becomes unreachable code, which is the exact fail-open this gate found in its own first implementation, twice. Or replace ci_assumption_problems() with a constant empty list: a forged CI marker satisfies the assumption the whole model rests on.
protected_modules.why_protected: Gate 4N-I28AP finding ADV-I28AP-01. This module is the sole adjudicator of the Docker execution boundary, and under Model B it is the ONLY thing standing between a repository-controlled steering mechanism and a daemon of the attacker's choosing. The daemon itself is an explicit external assumption; this layer is what makes that assumption meaningful rather than decorative.

protected_modules.why_protected: Gate 4N-I28AK. This module DERIVES which executables must be classified. A substituted copy would report a complete inventory while omitting a reachable executable, which is ADV-I28AJ-01 restored.

Protecting reverify (ADV-I28AL-03) without protecting the verifier it calls would be half a fix — the same attack succeeds one level down.
